Get Market Statistics

Source: R/functional_api.R
yf_get_market_stats.Rd

Retrieves key real-time valuation and summary fields for one or more tickers.

Usage

yf_get_market_stats(tickers)

Arguments

tickers

Character vector of stock symbols.

Value

A tibble with 7 columns: symbol (character), regular_market_price (numeric), fifty_two_week_high (numeric), fifty_two_week_low (numeric), regular_market_volume (numeric), previous_close (numeric), currency (character). Returns an empty tibble if all tickers fail.

See also

Other market data: get_market_summary(), get_trending()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
yf_get_market_stats("AAPL")
yf_get_market_stats(c("AAPL", "MSFT"))
} # }
